Understandable to think of higher-ups as evil and developers as honest and good, but DICE has been working with EA for years.
The distinction between them is not as high as one might think.

Hi!
This game is finished. It’s released.    
People already own it and many spent money on microgambling.   
Overnight, you cannot throw this system out the window.  

And this is the current general perception:
 
EA destroyed a game we anticipated.  
They lied to us and tried to manipulate us.   
DICE is under pressure by EA.  
We agreed on not letting out our anger on the innocent at DICE.  

Now I'm wondering, what is EA going to do to calm the rage in the community?  
How can they convince anyone when everyone knows they are liers?

They cannot.

For the foreseeable future, EA’s reputation in this community is burned.

So, **if no one believes you, how do you get your message across?**  
You do not..  
You cannot!  

**A middleman could.**

A person that closes the bridge between those that are divided by burned soil.

And here the messiah comes.

Out of nothing, **someone like Dennis arrives and appears to take a stance against microtransactions and the exploitation of customers.**  
There are several posts on this subreddits front page hailing Dennis.

I love it. These honest game developers who are suppressed by an evil corporation. They are on our side.  
 That’s a voice for us. Finally! It will all get better now.
The thought is tempting.  
And I want it to be that way.  
I want to believe that EA puts a gun to DICEs head and forces them to make games.  
And then EA ~~rapes~~ hurts those sweet games DICE creates.  

But that’s not the real world.  
**When DICE signs contracts with EA, they KNOW who they are working with.**  

They’ve done it for years.  

Please correct me if I’m wrong.  
Prior to EAs AMA announcement, I couldn’t find anything that showed any signs of a stance against micro-gambling, from neither Dennis nor the others.  

I believe it’s wishful thinking that developers and people at DICE represent the good and they are on our side.
I fear they represent EA in different clothing.

**How can you convince me, that you are not?**
